subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood evaluation & 60-day timeline for HealCo

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@healco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood evaluation & 60-day timeline for HealCo

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the throughput / latency profile and the autoscaling story. We're ready to formalize an evaluation and want to kick off a mutual action plan so everyone (product, infra, security) has clarity on goals, success metrics, and a timeline to close.

High level goals from HealCo:
- Validate Redwood's inference latency under 1.5x our production p95 for batch loads (2k rps).
- Verify privacy controls and audit logs for a subset of PHI-like test data.
- Confirm end-to-end integration with our test environment and a cost estimate for projected monthly usage.

Proposed timeline: 60 days starting Nov 29 (pilot infra available Nov 29 — we have a target contract discussion scheduled the week of Jan 4).

Attendees I plan to have involved:
- Alex Rivera (Champion, Product) — me
- Sally Chen (CTO) — will join technical kickoff
- DevOps: Ben Park (I'll introduce offline)

Can you (and Marissa from success) put together a one-page MAP we can share with stakeholders and propose a 45-minute kickoff next week? Also, please call out the roles we expect from HealCo vs Redwood.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Alex Rivera\Product Manager | HealCo Health

---

Alex — great to hear and thanks for the clear goals. I pulled together a short MAP outline (attached) and a proposed agenda for the kickoff so we can use the meeting to align owners and immediate next steps.

Key items in the attached MAP-outline-v1.pdf (summary):
- Success criteria: latency target, security controls, integration checklist, and cost gates.
- Owner matrix: who from Redwood owns infra, security evidence, and CS enablement.
- Week-by-week milestones across 8 weeks with explicit owner for each deliverable.

Proposed kickoff agenda (45 minutes):
1) Intros & success criteria (5m)
2) Technical scope and infra plan (15m) — include Sally + DevOps
3) Security & compliance checklist (10m) — evidence requirements for audit logs
4) Timeline, calendar, and decision points (10m)
5) Immediate next steps & action items (5m)

Proposed times (Pacific): Tue Nov 24 10:00–10:45 or Wed Nov 25 14:00–14:45. If those don't work we can push to Mon Nov 30.

I've cc'd Marissa who will be the Redwood CS lead coordinating the pilot and runbook. If you confirm attendees I will send an updated MAP and calendar invite.

Attachments: MAP-outline-v1.pdf (one page)

Cheers,
